neighbours.label: Execution verbs on their suffix piece: crucified/crucifixion, hanged, beheaded, executed
fire: The rebels were captured and hanged in the town square at dawn.
Many early martyrs were crucified by the Roman authorities.
The deposed king was beheaded before a silent crowd.
After the trial, the spy was executed by firing squad.
Paintings of the crucifixion hang in the chapel of the monastery.
Two of the conspirators were later hanged for treason.
The emperor ordered that the traitors be crucified along the road.
Several prisoners were executed in the courtyard of the fortress.
quiet: The rebels were captured and jailed in the town square at dawn.
Many early martyrs were persecuted by the Roman authorities.
The deposed king was exiled before a silent crowd.
After the trial, the spy was released by the court.
Paintings of the nativity hang in the chapel of the monastery.
Two of the conspirators were later pardoned for treason.
The emperor ordered that the traitors be banished from the city.
Several prisoners were questioned in the courtyard of the fortress.
